name: Export risers and subsea pipeline tie-ins to the CPP or FSO
description: Rigid flowlines and export pipelines carry oilfield fluids from wellhead/manifold to the processing facility and from offshore facilities to onshore receiving terminals; risers accommodate vessel motion and environmental loads between seabed flowlines/PLET and the surface host. TechnipFMC lists single pipelines, plastic-lined pipelines, corrosion-resistant alloy pipelines, direct electrically heated pipelines, pipe-in-pipe, electrically trace-heated pipe-in-pipe, piggybacked pipelines, steel cat Primary source: https://www.technipfmc.com/en/what-we-do/subsea/subsea-systems/subsea-infrastructure/rigid-pipelines/
